checks.detail: Web and native version authorities report 4.8.0.
Renderer paths and explicit fallback reason are modeled.
Device, driver, limits, extensions, support matrix and direct fixes are exposed.
2D rendering policy and diagnostics cover the required production surface.
Shader includes, metadata, compiler/platform diagnostics and bounded explicit fallback are connected.
Particle assets, live controls, collision, subemission and budgets are connected.
Audio graph, effects, automation, limiter and semantic meters are connected.
Playback, fades, playlist/randomization, streaming and bounded voice policies are represented.
Audio device selection, hot plug and recovery are implemented with diagnostics.
Profiler capture, comparison, annotations, remote field and CI export are connected.
Project-owned performance budgets cover frame, GPU, renderer, particles and profiler overhead.
Project Health and Build Settings consume renderer/audio production diagnostics.
The v4.8 UI vocabulary is supplied in English, German and Chinese.
Renderer path, fallback policy and every budget normalize to documented bounds.
Valid shaders pass; invalid/platform-divergent shaders fail visibly and fallback is recorded.

platformDiagnostics.message: Custom shader output is unsupported on Canvas2D and will use the explicit base-material fallback.

checks.detail: Audio device, limiter, graph-cycle and automation inputs normalize deterministically.
Particle rates, lifetime and collision settings remain finite and bounded.
CI performance budgets reject invalid or unbounded values.
Captures save, compare and export deterministic CI budget results.
